about: Mistake and pattern cards from the Treino app's database, mirrored here by the Coach so the build makes their audio. The database is the source of truth.

cards.pt: A viagem foi longa.
cards.en: The journey was long.
cards.lit: The trip was long
cards.why: longe = far away; a long trip is longa

cards.sheet: Tô muito animado de estar aqui
cards.pt: Tô muito animado de estar aqui.
cards.en: I'm really excited to be here.
cards.lit: I'm very excited of to-be here
cards.why: need 'de' before a verb

cards.pt: Trabalho com câmbio.
cards.en: I work in FX.
cards.lit: I work with exchange
cards.why: trabalhar com + your area

cards.pt: Gosto, sim!
cards.en: Yes, I do! (answering: do you like it?)
cards.lit: Like, yes!
cards.why: say yes by repeating the verb

cards.sheet: e depois a gente se viu
cards.pt: E depois a gente se viu em Londres.
cards.en: And then we saw each other in London.
cards.lit: And after, we saw ourselves in London
cards.why: então = so; depois = then/later

cards.pt: A gente se conheceu pessoalmente em Londres.
cards.en: We met in person in London.
cards.lit: We got-to-know ourselves personally in London
cards.why: natural word for 'in person'

cards.sheet: Tenho um irmão e duas irmãs
cards.pt: Tenho um irmão e duas irmãs.
cards.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
cards.said: Temho um irmao e duas irmas
cards.why: nh spelling; nasal ão / ãs

cards.pt: Na sexta eu trabalho de casa.
cards.en: On Fridays I work from home.
cards.lit: On Friday I work from house
cards.why: work from home = trabalhar de casa (or em casa)

cards.sheet: Como se diz isso em inglês?
cards.pt: Como se diz isso em inglês?
cards.en: How do you say that in English?
cards.lit: How itself says this in English?
cards.why: ask 'how do you say it' with como se diz

cards.pt: Trabalhei o dia inteiro.
cards.en: I worked all day.
cards.lit: Worked the day entire
cards.why: past tense for what already happened; no 'do'

cards.pt: Tem muitas festas em dezembro.
cards.en: There are lots of parties in December.
cards.lit: Has many parties in December
cards.why: muito agrees with the noun: muitas festas

cards.sheet: Danço muito mal / danço muito bem
cards.pt: Eu danço muito mal.
cards.en: I dance really badly.
cards.why: bem/mal = adverbs for verbs; bom = adjective for nouns

cards.pt: Eu não sou muito bom nisso.
cards.en: I'm not very good at it.
cards.lit: I not am very good in-this
cards.why: need the verb ser: não sou

cards.sheet: A Gabi não é muito boa
cards.pt: A Gabi não é muito boa nisso.
cards.en: Gabi isn't very good at it.
cards.lit: The Gabi not is very good in-this
cards.why: não goes before the verb; boa for a woman

cards.pt: Vou viajar com a Gabi.
cards.en: I'm going to travel with Gabi.
cards.lit: Go to-travel with the Gabi
cards.why: Gabi is a woman: a Gabi

cards.sheet: Vou morar com a minha família
cards.pt: Vou morar com a minha família.
cards.en: I'm going to live with my family.
cards.lit: Go to-live with the my family
cards.said: Eu vou moro na minha família
cards.why: vou + infinitive (morar); morar com = live with

cards.sheet: Quero ir pra Colômbia / pra Medellín
cards.pt: Quero ir pra Colômbia.
cards.en: I want to go to Colombia.
cards.lit: Want to-go to-the Colombia
cards.said: Quero vou para / Quero ir em Medellín
cards.why: quero + infinitive; ir pra a place, not 'em'

cards.sheet: Vou economizar dinheiro porque quero viajar pelo mundo todo
cards.pt: Vou economizar dinheiro porque quero viajar pelo mundo todo.
cards.en: I'm going to save money because I want to travel all over the world.
cards.lit: Go to-save money because want to-travel through-the world whole
cards.said: Vou economizar pro dinheiro porque eu quero viagem em todo mundo
cards.why: no 'pro' after economizar; viajar is the verb; pelo mundo todo

cards.sheet: Quero viajar pela América do Sul por seis meses
cards.pt: Quero viajar pela América do Sul por seis meses.
cards.en: I want to travel around South America for six months.
cards.lit: Want to-travel through-the America of-the South for six months
cards.said: Quero viajar à América do Sul de seis meses
cards.why: por = for a duration; pela for 'around/through'

cards.pt: O Spurs perde muito.
cards.en: Spurs lose a lot.
cards.lit: The Spurs loses much
cards.why: present for a habit (perde), not past (perdi)

cards.pt: A gente não perde sempre!
cards.en: We don't always lose!
cards.lit: The people (we) not loses always
cards.why: lose = perder

cards.pt: Tenho que arrumar a casa.
cards.en: I have to tidy the house.
cards.lit: Have that to-tidy the house
cards.why: tidy up = arrumar

cards.pt: Porque é mais barato.
cards.en: Because it's cheaper.
cards.lit: Because is more cheap
cards.why: cheaper = mais barato
cards.q: Por que cê vai morar com a sua família?

cards.pt: Depois de São Paulo, vou pro Rio.
cards.en: After São Paulo, I'm going to Rio.
cards.lit: After of São Paulo, go to-the Rio
cards.why: going to a place = ir pra; pro = pra + o
cards.q: E depois de São Paulo, cê vai pra onde?

cards.pt: Estudei por um mês e meio antes de vir.
cards.en: I studied for a month and a half before coming.
cards.lit: Studied for a month and half before of to-come
cards.why: por = for a length of time

cards.pt: A Gabi mora com a mãe dela.
cards.en: Gabi lives with her mum.
cards.lit: The Gabi lives with the mother of-her
cards.why: live with someone = morar com
cards.q: E a Gabi, mora com quem?

cards.pt: Quero andar pela Paulista no domingo.
cards.en: I want to walk along Paulista on Sunday.
cards.lit: Want to-walk through-the Paulista on-the Sunday
cards.why: pela = along or around a place (por + a)
cards.q: O que cê quer fazer em São Paulo?
